presets.label: Weekly status
presets.description: For the delivery team. Everything, including the source rows.

presets.label: Steering committee
presets.description: For the people who decide. Findings and the options, without the record-level appendix.

presets.label: Executive brief
presets.description: One page. The outlook and what is driving it, nothing to work through.

sections.title: Summary
sections.description: The four questions, in prose: what is at risk, why, what it impacts, what to do next.

sections.title: Findings
sections.description: Every finding with its recommendation, the rule that fired and the causal chain behind it.

sections.title: Source rows
sections.description: The spreadsheet and Jira records each finding rests on. Switch off for an audience that will not check them.

sections.title: Schedule projection
sections.description: The slip the dependency chain implies but the sheet does not yet show, driving path first.

sections.title: Recovery scenarios
sections.description: What shortening a task or overlapping a dependency would recover, measured against the original commitment.

sections.title: Delivery forecast
sections.description: A range of finish dates, resampled from how far this plan has already drifted from its own baselines.

sections.title: Risk register
sections.description: The risks a PM has recorded, with their pre- and post-mitigation ratings.

sections.title: What this analysis could not use
sections.description: Rejected rows, uncertain identities and inferred dependencies. Kept in every preset on purpose.

formats.description: Every table on its own sheet, filterable and sortable.
